guide.summary: After Jesus' ascension, the Holy Spirit descended at Pentecost transforming timid disciples into courageous apostles. The early Church was born with power, unity and authenticity, growing exponentially despite persecution.

keyVerses.text: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages.
They continued steadfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship.

exercises.text: "But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon _____.
exercises.speaker: Jesus
exercises.explanation: Jesus promises that the Holy Spirit will come upon the disciples to empower them.

exercises.statement: The promise of the Holy Spirit was fulfilled immediately after Jesus' resurrection.
exercises.explanation: The disciples had to wait several days until Pentecost to receive the Holy Spirit.

exercises.prompt: Why did Jesus ask the disciples to wait?
exercises.text: Jesus asked them to remain in Jerusalem for the promise of the Father.
exercises.explanation: The Holy Spirit would be the power needed for them to be witnesses of Jesus.

exercises.text: Promise of power in Acts 1:8
tokens: and you will be my witnesses
distractors: to the ends of the earth

exercises.text: You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you.
options: The Holy Spirit will empower us
Receive power from the Holy Spirit
exercises.answer: Receive power from the Holy Spirit

exercises.text: "You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon _____."

exercises.statement: The Holy Spirit empowers us to do everything God calls us to do.
exercises.explanation: The Holy Spirit is the power that makes us effective witnesses of Christ.

exercises.text: "They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other _____."
exercises.speaker: Luke
exercises.explanation: The visible and audible sign of Pentecost was that all began to speak in other languages.

exercises.statement: Pentecost marks the official birth of the Christian Church.
exercises.explanation: Pentecost is when the first 3,000 were converted and the Church began.

exercises.prompt: What happened when Peter preached at Pentecost?
exercises.text: The first sermon after the Holy Spirit descended resulted in many converts.
exercises.explanation: Peter's preaching resulted in 3,000 disciples being added to the newborn Church.

exercises.text: The sign of Pentecost in Acts 2:2-3
They were all filled with the Holy Spirit.
"They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other _____."

exercises.statement: Pentecost was a unique event that never happened again.
exercises.explanation: While Pentecost is the initial event, the filling of the Holy Spirit repeated several times in Acts.

exercises.text: "They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship with one _____."
exercises.speaker: Luke
exercises.explanation: The early Church was characterized by apostolic teaching and genuine fellowship.

exercises.statement: The early Church held all things in common and sold properties to help the needy.
exercises.explanation: The generosity of the early Church was remarkable, sharing everything freely.

exercises.prompt: What was the people's attitude toward the early Church?
exercises.text: Luke describes the reputation and growth of the newborn Church.
options: They had favor with the people and grew
exercises.answer: They had favor with the people and grew
exercises.explanation: The Church had favor with the people and the Lord added new converts daily.

exercises.text: Characteristics of the early Church
They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching.
options: They learned the words of Jesus

exercises.prompt: Match the characteristics of the Church

exercises.text: "They devoted themselves to the apostles' teaching and to fellowship with one _____."

exercises.statement: The early Church was selfish and everyone cared only for themselves.
exercises.explanation: The early Church was characterized by altruism and generous sharing of resources.

exercises.prompt: Who was healed first by the apostles after Pentecost?
exercises.text: A dramatic miracle opened the way for more preaching.
options: A lame beggar at the Beautiful Gate
exercises.answer: A lame beggar at the Beautiful Gate
exercises.explanation: Peter healed a man who had never walked, causing general amazement.

exercises.statement: The miracles of the early Church were performed in the name of Jesus Christ.
exercises.explanation: Peter emphasizes that miracles occur through faith in the name of Jesus.

exercises.text: Their preaching attracted authorities who feared their influence.
options: They preached about Jesus and performed miracles
exercises.answer: They preached about Jesus and performed miracles
exercises.explanation: Religious authorities feared that the message about Jesus would spread.

exercises.text: Power in the name of Jesus in Acts 3:6
tokens: Silver and gold I do not have
but what I do have I give you
In the name of Jesus Christ

exercises.text: Silver and gold I do not have but I give you in the name of Jesus.
options: Silver and gold have no value
No silver give in Jesus name
exercises.answer: No silver give in Jesus name

exercises.prompt: Match the miracles to their results

exercises.text: "In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, _____.

exercises.statement: The apostles' miracles happened even when they faced opposition.
exercises.explanation: Persecution did not stop the power and miracles of the early Church.

exercises.prompt: How did Jesus prepare His disciples for Pentecost?
exercises.text: After His resurrection, Jesus gave specific instructions.
options: He promised that the Holy Spirit would come with power
He said they would be persecuted
He ordered them to leave immediately
He did not specially prepare them
exercises.answer: He promised that the Holy Spirit would come with power
exercises.explanation: Jesus promised the Holy Spirit and power to be witnesses.

exercises.statement: The early Church faced persecution but continued growing.
exercises.explanation: Despite arrests and threats, the early Church grew exponentially.

exercises.prompt: What was the secret of the early Church's success?
exercises.text: Several factors contributed to its extraordinary growth.
options: Apostolic teaching, fellowship, prayer and miracles
exercises.answer: Apostolic teaching, fellowship, prayer and miracles
exercises.explanation: The foundation was spiritual, not material or political.

exercises.text: Summary of Pentecost and Church
You will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come.
Sequence of Acts 1-2

exercises.statement: The history of the early Church is a model for Christian faith today.
exercises.explanation: The power, unity and growth of the early Church continue to inspire us.
